text: Create an event log for all Maintenance Request cases that contains only the activities Request Opened and Request Closed.
For every Maintenance Request, give me an event log limited to two events: the request being raised and the request being concluded.
Build an event log for all Part Reservation cases that contains only the activity Part Issued.
For every Part Reservation, I need an event log that keeps a single kind of event: a part being handed out from the store.
Produce an event log for all Work Order cases that contains only the activities Work Order Opened and Work Order Closed.
Give me an event log covering every Work Order, limited to two events: the work order being created and the work order being brought to a close.
Create an event log for all Technician cases that contains only the activities Technician Assigned, Work Item Started and Work Item Finished.
For every Technician, build an event log limited to three events: the technician being designated for a job, a work item being commenced and a work item being completed.
Build an event log for all Equipment cases that contains only the activities Fault Reported, Inspection Performed, Component Replaced, Function Tested and Equipment Accepted.

For every piece of Equipment, give me an event log limited to five events: a malfunction being flagged, an inspection being carried out, a component being swapped out, a functional test being run and the equipment being signed off as fit for service.
Produce an event log for all Work Item cases that contains only the activities Part Allocated, Part Issued, Component Replaced and Work Item Finished.

For every Work Item, I need an event log limited to four events: a part being earmarked for the job, a part being handed out from the store, a component being swapped out and the work item being completed.
Create an event log for all Maintenance Request cases that contains only the activities Request Triaged, Risk Assessed and Request Approved.
Give me an event log covering every Maintenance Request, limited to three events: the request being prioritized by urgency, the risk being evaluated and the request being authorized.
Build an event log for all Work Order cases that contains only the activities Reservation Opened, Part Allocated, Stock Checked and Part Issued.

For every Work Order, build an event log limited to four events: a parts reservation being created, a part being earmarked for the job, inventory availability being looked up and a part being handed out from the store.
Produce an event log for all Equipment cases that contains only the activities Adjustment Made and Component Replaced.
For every piece of Equipment, I need an event log limited to two events: an adjustment being carried out and a component being swapped out.
Create an event log for all Technician cases that contains only the activities Inspection Performed, Function Tested, Verification Started and Reading Taken.

Give me an event log covering every Technician, limited to four events: an inspection being conducted, a functional test being run, the verification getting under way and a measurement being recorded.
Create an event log for all Equipment cases that covers the complete history of each case, that is, every activity associated with Equipment across all of its phases.
For every piece of Equipment, give me the full event log: everything that happens to it in every phase it takes part in, with nothing left out.
Build an event log for all Maintenance Request cases with the complete history of each case, including every activity associated with a Maintenance Request across all of its phases.
I need the entire story of every Maintenance Request as an event log, covering whatever happens to it in each of the phases it belongs to.
Produce an event log for all Work Item cases covering the complete history of each case: every activity associated with a Work Item across all of its phases.
For every Work Item, build an event log of its whole history, spanning all the phases it is involved in and omitting nothing that happens to it.
Create an event log for all Technician cases that contains the complete history of each case, meaning every activity associated with a Technician across all of its phases.
Give me an event log covering every Technician in full: all that is associated with the Technician across every phase the Technician takes part in.
Create an event log for all Maintenance Request cases covering everything that happens in the intake phase for each case.
For every Maintenance Request, I need an event log limited to the intake phase, containing all that takes place for the request in that phase.
Build an event log for all Work Order cases covering everything that happens in the parts phase for each case.
Give me an event log for every Work Order that is confined to the parts phase and includes all that occurs for the work order within that phase.
Produce an event log for all Technician cases covering everything that happens in the field work phase for each case.
For every Technician, build an event log restricted to the field work phase, with the whole of what happens for the Technician during that phase.
Create an event log for all Equipment cases covering everything that happens in the acceptance phase for each case.
For every piece of Equipment, I need an event log of the acceptance phase only, including all that takes place for the Equipment in that phase.
Build an event log for all Work Order cases covering everything that happens in the work planning phase for each case.
Give me an event log covering every Work Order within the work planning phase alone, with all that occurs for the work order in that phase.
Produce an event log for all Work Item cases covering everything that happens in the parts phase for each case.
For every Work Item, build an event log that stays within the parts phase and contains the whole of what happens for the Work Item there.
